name: Fenir
source:
Pronouns: He/Him
Occupation: Hydra (Librarian)

Likes: Peace, quiet
Dislikes: Loud people, people who talk too much
Hobbies: Reading, writing short stories, apothecary

Powers: Confidential
Signature Technique: Unavailable
Dragon Spring: Fafnir

The local book-keeper, Fenir is the Hydra of Central. This means he manages and oversees the library. For unknown reasons, he does not appear well-connected at Central. Strange, given his position. Few visit him to speak or seek his help at the library. He seems to be a creature of solitude. Is this by choice?

Fenir is the one who saved you when you were attacked. While you were unaware at the time, it seems you both work at Central together. But while he holds a high-ranking position at Central, he was banned from using his powers. A surely unique situation.

[From in-game profile]
